ctx.x: But some people claim they are different.

Some people didn't. Like Dr. Sushon, for instance, who heard them up there and had heard them down here, and a few other people, have claimed that there was some difference already as soon as they got up there.
Well, Mr. Russell, what are you doing now at Tulane in this sort of research project towards preservation of jazz?
